latin: Siquis in opere precedentis conclusionis intellectualiter operabitur, per meridiem ligabit septentrionem; si uero mundialiter per totum operabitur, iudicium sibi operabitur.
translation: Working the preceding conclusion intellectually binds the north by means of the south; working it in a wholly worldly way brings judgment down upon the operator himself.
